name: smu-lit-sct-prefiling-server
description: SCT pre-filing agent harness for an internal unauthenticated demo.

scripts.dev:prefilled: PREFILLED=true DATA_DIR=./data/prefilled FLUE_DB_PATH=./data/prefilled/flue.db CASE_DB_PATH=./data/prefilled/cases.db EVIDENCE_DIR=./data/prefilled/evidence SNAPSHOT_DIR=./data/prefilled/snapshots vite dev
scripts.dev:demo: MOCK_DATA_MODE=true PREFILLED=true DATA_DIR=./data/demo FLUE_DB_PATH=./data/demo/flue.db CASE_DB_PATH=./data/demo/cases.db EVIDENCE_DIR=./data/demo/evidence SNAPSHOT_DIR=./data/demo/snapshots vite dev
scripts.check: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint && pnpm test && pnpm run build
